description: Stitch 2–4 plan sheets together into a composite working surface across match-lines (#161) — the browser canvas's Stitched Sheets feature. Shapes traced on the returned stitch reference bind to the composite key ("stitch:<uid>") and measure continuously across seam boundaries once aligned. By default sheets create in auto-butt layout (aligned: false). Use align_stitch with two matching reference points to align sheets across their match line and run the automated linework seam check; measuring across a seam on an unaligned or withheld stitch is refused. Member sheets must have calibrated, matching scales. Coordinates are image px at render scale 2.0: PDF pt × 2, origin top-left, y down (the browser canvas's native space). Sheet payloads carry dims in both px and pt.

anchor.description: First alignment point in image px

moving.description: Second alignment point in image px — sheet under moving translates to anchor

members.description: Explicit member sheet placements in image px (alternative to auto-butt or align)

name.description: Optional human-readable label for the composite sheet (defaults to "Stitched sheets")

sheets.description: 2–4 sheet keys or sheet numbers to stitch together

name: stitch_sheets

aligned.description: true = aligned across match lines; false = starting auto-butt layout

extent.description: Composite surface dimensions in image px at render scale 2.0

members.description: Member sheet placements within the composite surface

scale.description: Scale status inherited from member sheets, if all member scales agree

seam_check.description: Seam linework check results when align was provided

discrepancies.description: Discrepancy locations along the match line

at.description: Stitch coordinates along the seam line to inspect with view_sheet

leftover_rotation_deg.description: Leftover rotation between member sheets in degrees

max_in.description: True maximum linework displacement in inches at set scale

max_px.description: True maximum linework displacement in image pixels

median_in.description: Median linework displacement in inches at set scale

median_px.description: Median linework displacement in image pixels

p95_in.description: 95th percentile linework displacement in inches at set scale

p95_px.description: 95th percentile linework displacement in image pixels

passed.description: true = linework mismatch and leftover rotation are within stated tolerances

sample_count.description: Number of wall linework crossings sampled across the match line

withheld.description: true = seam check did not pass tolerance; measuring across seam is refused

withheld_reasons.description: Disclosed reasons for withholding if tolerances are exceeded

stitch_id.description: The created composite surface key (starts with stitch:)
